# DZNE - Deutsches Zentrum für Neurodegenerative Erkrankungen

> > DZNE is Germany's leading research center for understanding, decoding causes, and developing therapies for neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and frontotemporal dementia.

DZNE operates multiple research locations across Germany (Berlin, Bonn, Dresden, Göttingen) with integrated programs spanning basic science, clinical research, population studies, and patient care. The organization combines advanced imaging technology, tissue biobanking, and systems medicine approaches to accelerate therapeutic development for age-related neurological conditions.

## Key Topics

- Alzheimer's disease
- Parkinson's disease
- ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis)
- Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD)
- Clinical trials
- Brain biomarkers
- Neuroimaging (MRI, AI)
- Systems medicine
- Neuropathology
- Translational research
- Patient recruitment
- Scientific integrity
- Swarm Learning
- Brain Bank
- Neuroscience research

## Research Overview & Strategy

- [DZNE Homepage](https://www.dzne.de): DZNE homepage introducing neurodegenerative disease research including Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and FTD.
- [DZNE English Homepage](https://www.dzne.de/en): DZNE English homepage covering neuroscience research, clinical trials, and brain biomarkers.
- [Research Overview](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/uebersicht): DZNE research overview covering neurodegeneration, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, FTD, and ALS.
- [Research Areas](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/forschungsbereiche): Research areas overview: basic, clinical, population studies, and care research.

## Research Programs & Projects

- [Research Groups Directory](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/forschungsgruppen): Directory of DZNE research groups across Berlin, Bonn, Dresden, and Göttingen.
- [Clinical Studies & Trials](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/studien): Overview of DZNE clinical trials, population research, and study participation.
- [Research Projects](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/projekte): DZNE research projects including Cure-ND, BaoBab, explAInation, EU-Atlas.
- [Human Imaging Unit](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/human-imaging): Human Imaging Unit research using MRI technology and AI for brain imaging studies.
- [Brain Bank](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/brain-bank): DZNE Brain Bank for tissue donation and neuropathology research on neurodegenerative diseases.

## Clinical Research & Patient Engagement

- [Clinical Research for Patients & Families](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/forschungsbereiche/klinische-forschung/betroffene-und-angehoerige): Clinical research information for patients and families with Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and FTD.
- [Swarm Learning Hub](https://www.dzne.de/swarm-learning-hub/welcome): Swarm Learning Hub for systems medicine, machine learning, and collaborative disease research.
- [Dementia Facts & Information](https://www.dzne.de/aktuelles/hintergrund/faktenzentrale): Dementia facts and information on Alzheimer's, Lewy body, vascular, and frontotemporal dementia.

## Scientific Resources & Services

- [Scientific Services & Core Facilities](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/wissenschaftliche-services): Scientific services including Core Facilities, PRECISE, and Biorepository resources.
- [Publications Database](https://pub.dzne.de/collection/VDB): DZNE publications database for neuroscience and aging research articles.
- [Office of Scientific Integrity](https://www.dzne.de/forschung/office-of-scientific-integrity): Scientific integrity office ensuring research ethics and institutional compliance.
